stem.text: What describes the quaternary structure of a collagen molecule?

A.text: polypeptides that form an $\alpha$-helix, which are held together by covalent bonds

B.text: polypeptides that form a double helix, which are held together by hydrogen bonds

C.text: four polypeptides that are held together by covalent bonds, which form a helix

D.text: three polypeptides that form helix structures, which are held together by hydrogen and covalent bonds
